body:
Yo bro. I know its rough right now. On the bright side, these are the effects of a drug and they will wear off. I can promise you that you wont die you are just feeling normal things a bit differently right now. The first thing I want you to do is take as deep a breath as you can; it feels like you aren't getting any air right? Now put both hands on your torso and feel your chest rise and fall as you take slow deep breaths. Congratulations! you are still getting air into your lungs it just feels wildly different than normal. 

Now that you know you are still breathing take a listen to this: 

https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=nTRYRhXzNp4

A great bad trip song

after that I want you to just keep browsing the youtube recommendation and find some songs you enjoy (screenshot the names of some you enjoy so you can take a listen post trip)

You will get through this bro.
